modeling_role: Defines the industries or commodities represented by rows and columns
review_requirement: Document sector classification aggregation level region table year and table source
responsible_use_warning: Sector aggregation can hide specialized supply-chain bottlenecks and distributional effects

modeling_role: Defines how transactions are converted into technical coefficients
review_requirement: Record transaction source output denominator price basis domestic/import treatment and matrix orientation
responsible_use_warning: Technical coefficients are assumptions about fixed production relationships not timeless production laws

modeling_role: Solves total gross output required for final demand
review_requirement: Check invertibility numerical stability plausibility and economically meaningful output levels
responsible_use_warning: A mathematically valid solution may still be infeasible under capacity price labor or material constraints

modeling_role: Summarizes direct and indirect output requirements
review_requirement: Define the multiplier type and attach accounting boundaries
responsible_use_warning: Multipliers are not automatic measures of welfare productivity social value or policy priority

modeling_role: Defines the final-demand vector or demand shock being modeled
review_requirement: Document scenario source units timing price basis affected sectors and uncertainty
responsible_use_warning: Demand shocks are what-if assumptions not forecasts unless externally validated

modeling_role: Distinguishes domestic requirements from total requirements
review_requirement: State whether coefficients are domestic total import-adjusted regional national or multi-region
responsible_use_warning: Local and domestic effects can be overstated when import leakage is ignored

modeling_role: Maps production requirements into emissions energy water labor income or other indicators
review_requirement: Document extension source year units sector match and uncertainty
responsible_use_warning: Extensions can inherit both coefficient uncertainty and footprint-factor uncertainty

modeling_role: Defines what the model can and cannot support
review_requirement: Attach interpretation limits uncertainty notes validation status and stop-use conditions to outputs
responsible_use_warning: Input-output analysis should inform economic systems reasoning not replace accountable policy judgment
